summary:
Implemented all 5 flagship innovations for UniSync BrainMate:
1. Reciprocal 'Skill Swap' Matching Engine with bilateral synergy scoring and barter proposals.
2. Live Focus Pod with synchronized Pomodoro sprints, Web Audio ambient soundscapes, shared goals Kanban, collaborative scratchpad, and peer cheer reactions.
3. Smart Free-Time Overlap Heatmap with 7-day timetable clash detector and 1-click slot booking.
4. Group Syllabus Burndown & Exam Readiness Tracker with weighted module mastery radar, cohort benchmarks, and live exam countdown.
5. Peer Academic Endorsement & Study Karma Ledger with micro-credentials, reliability scoring, and community feedback.
